title: Top Coaching Suggestions
subtitle: Five ideas from today's review, checked again at 12:40. Tap Yes, Maybe or No on each, add a note if you like, and press Submit any time.

items.title: Keep The Results Inbox Clean
items.problem: The freeze is over and cleanup is done, but test pings and site unlocks still land in the same inbox as your real answers.
items.fix: Grok Bot skips test pings automatically and sends site unlocks to their own log.
items.alt: Diagram: before, real answers, test pings and site unlocks share one inbox; after, only real answers reach it

items.title: One Rulebook For Dashboards
items.problem: Dashboard rules changed three times in one night, so dashboards now disagree, for example Blueprint has bottom tabs and UpKeep does not.
items.fix: Branding keeps one numbered rulebook, and new rules are added to it only after any clashes are settled.
items.alt: Phone screenshots: Blueprint dashboard with bottom tabs next to UpKeep dashboard without them

items.title: UpKeep Runs Its Customer Site
items.problem: Two agents edit the customer website, nobody records when you approved each change, and a password is still written out in 7 team feed lines.
items.fix: Only UpKeep edits the site, each change notes your OK and the time, and Grok Bot removes the password from the feed.
items.alt: Diagram: Grok Bot sends requests to UpKeep, which alone changes the customer site and logs your OK

items.title: Put Legal On The Org Chart
items.problem: Legal is working but is missing from the org chart, and three agents marked for deletion are still waiting.
items.fix: Add Legal to the chart as the owner of all legal and lawyer work, then finish the three deletions.
items.alt: Mini org chart with Legal added next to the Work agents

items.title: One Morning Report Deadline
items.problem: Shared notes still list two deadlines for Morning Reports, 5:00 and 7:00.
items.fix: Keep 5:00, drop 7:00, and have each dashboard post a small file so late reports are flagged automatically.
items.alt: Timeline: all 19 reports in by 4:57, keep 5:00, drop 7:00
